Here, we assess SWOT observability of irrigation canal networks across 22 Asian countries using a new confidence level (CL) metric. Validation against in situ gauge observations showed that higher CL corresponds to significantly lower water\u2010level retrieval error. Of approximately 795,110\u00a0km of canals analyzed, 37.5% (297,799\u00a0km) show high confidence, 46.9% (373,035\u00a0km) moderate confidence, and 15.6% (124,276\u00a0km) low confidence of observability. Observability is highest in the Indus Basin, Indo\u2010Gangetic Plain, Bangladesh delta, North China Plain, and parts of Myanmar, the Philippines, Nepal, and the Mekong delta, and lowest across parts of Central Asia. Our analysis indicates SWOT can meaningfully support irrigation canal water monitoring across much of Asia's most intensively irrigated regions and around the
